name: nfse-hub
description: Plataforma SaaS Multiempresa de Gestão e Emissão de NFS-e (Contabilidade & Automação VPS)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB,WORKER -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build:base: npm run build --workspace=@nfse-hub/nfse-types && npm run build --workspace=@nfse-hub/fiscal-core && npm run build --workspace=@nfse-hub/xml-engine && npm run build --workspace=@nfse-hub/municipality-registry && npm run build --workspace=@nfse-hub/national-sefin && npm run build --workspace=@nfse-hub/nota-control-df
scripts.build: npm run build:base && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:base && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
